validated_results.title: Complex interaction between serum folate levels and genetic polymorphisms in folate pathway genes: biomarkers of prostate cancer aggressiveness.
validated_results.reason: This case-control study evaluated the association between serum folate levels and incident prostate cancer risk in Jamaican men.

extraction.population: clinic-based men attending urology clinics in Jamaica

sample_size.excerpt: The study population consisted of 218 prostate cancer cases and 236 controls. Men diagnosed with prostate cancer were older, shorter, and were less likely to have secondary or higher education than controls (Table 1 ).

cases.excerpt: The study population consisted of 218 prostate cancer cases and 236 controls. Men diagnosed with prostate cancer were older, shorter, and were less likely to have secondary or higher education than controls (Table 1 ).

effect_size.excerpt: Serum folate concentration showed a positive association with prostate cancer (OR, 4.41; CI, 2.52–7.72 per 10 nmol/L) regardless of grade.

confidence_interval.excerpt: Serum folate was positively related to total prostate cancer (OR, 4.41; CI, 2.52–7.72 per 10 nmol/L) and subgrades of disease.
